title: A reward from a parent
subtitle: Extra time or a later bedtime shows up on Riley's {{device}} as soon as a parent gives it.

steps.say: Riley finished the science project, so a parent sends a reward from the dashboard.
Riley sees the reward and has 20 more minutes today.
It's Friday, so bedtime moves an hour later too, for tonight only.
Tomorrow, the usual rules come back on their own.
